changes.title: Sail in place
items: To try with ?sail=inplace on the link: sail from the map table's chart to another island without the page reloading; the music fades to the sea and the wind while you cross, and the new night's music starts as you land
After sailing that way, Back opens the pause menu instead of leaving the game
If sailing that way goes wrong, the island loads the old way instead, with no message

changes.title: First run text
items: The controls on the start card are up to date: the treehouse (its sea chart, the dressing stations, the bed), T and Shift for talking, and the gamepad's buttons as they are now
The sea chart says how islands are found: do a legend's quest and win the night

changes.title: Bed new forest
items: Sleeping in the treehouse's bed now wakes you in a new forest, not the same night again
